ns2:section.sectionText: URH Dialogue Course. Second half-session class. 1 hour (letter-graded) credit. 45399 RH1 GREEK AND NONGREEK. Day and Time: Tuesdays, 3 pm - 4:50 pm. Starting Date: March 14. Location: TBA. ENROLLMENT BY APPLICATION, through the Program on Intergroup Relations (PIR), 110 Turner Student Services Building, 610 E. John, Champaign. Priority enrollment will be given to University Residence Hall students. See: www.intergrouprelations.uiuc.edu for courses and enrollment information, including the application form. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call the PIR Office at 244-3356.
